title: Charat Singh Covers Sirhind While the Fort Is Stormed

blocks.text: At the critical pause before the breach, Charat Singh made a bold declaration that he would hold the Sirhind side himself. By taking responsibility for that flank, he frees the rest of the Khalsa to concentrate on opening the fort and carrying the assault inward.

His movement unsettles the Pathan side and helps spread panic beyond the walls, while the main Sikh force prepares to storm the enclosure at close quarters. The page presents coordinated action rather than chaotic fury: one side contains reinforcement, the other presses the breach.

Once the attack gathers full force, the Singhs climb without ladders and force their way into the stronghold with improvised means and relentless momentum. The fall of the position turns the Morinda action from siege into interior retribution.
